text: Ephesdammim: Or, the coast of Dammim | set the battle: Heb. ranged the battle
cheeses: Heb. cheeses of milk | captain of their thousand: Heb. captain of a thousand
trench: Or, place of the carriage | the fight: Or, battle ray, or place of fight
his carriage: Heb. the vessels from upon him | saluted his brethren: Heb. asked his brethren of peace
from him: Heb. from his face
sent for him: Heb. took him
armed...with his armour: Heb. clothed, etc. with his clothes
brook: Or, valley | bag: Heb. vessell
deliver thee: Heb. shut thee up
